_source: HF 3dlg-hcvc/ReVSI @ 345a811 (apache-2.0); vlmeval class ReVSI (vlmeval/dataset/revsi.py, ported from official VLMEvalKit revsi.py @ f5296f0 / lmms-eval tasks/revsi @ 9134731). Questions: parquet subset 64_frame restricted to metadata/tiny_set_question_ids.txt. Frames: official pre-sampled video.zip:64_frame/<scene>.mp4 (exactly 64 frames). Paper's proprietary-model tiny set (metadata/tiny_set_question_ids.txt, 1,093 ids; 1,057 in the 64-frame subset). Not comparable to the full-set open-source numbers.
_frames: ReVSI.build_prompt sends the raw 64-frame mp4 as a video message without sampling keys; the client samples with model-level nframes=64 (video_sampling below), and qwen-vl-utils linspace(0,63,64) on a 64-frame video is the identity, so all 64 official frames are sent (scripts/check_revsi_frames.py; scripts/check_video_sampling.py). Dataset nframe=64 is the non-VIDEO_LLM path (all 64 frames as images) and is enforced by the class.
